# akeyless_target_details (Ephemeral Resource)

Fetches target details (including credentials) without storing them in Terraform state.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Target name

### Optional

- `show_versions` (Boolean) Include all target versions in reply
- `target_version` (Number) Target version

### Read-Only

- `value` (Map of String, Sensitive) Target credentials/details map (same shape as the data source).
